offering_description.value: Waters sells analytical instruments, consumables and laboratory software to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research and industrial laboratories. It also supplies flow cytometry systems and reagents to research and clinical laboratories, and microbiology and molecular diagnostic systems to clinical laboratories. It develops and manufactures instruments and consumables and provides installation, maintenance and training.

primary_products.value: liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry systems, columns and software; flow cytometers and research reagents; clinical microbiology systems and media; molecular diagnostic systems and assays; thermal analysis and materials characterization instruments

primary_services.value: instrument installation and qualification; preventive maintenance and repair; laboratory software implementation; operator training

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, universities and industrial testing laboratories; B2G: public health, regulatory and government research laboratories

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals and biotechnology; clinical diagnostics; academic and government research; chemicals and materials; food and environmental testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: laboratory instruments, chromatography columns, reagents, assays and other consumables; service fees: instrument maintenance agreements, repairs, qualification and training; licensing or royalties: laboratory data acquisition, analysis and management software
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds laboratory instruments and makes columns, reagents and assays for research, industrial and clinical laboratories; service provider: installs, qualifies and maintains laboratory instruments for their operators; software / platform: develops software that captures, analyzes and manages instrument data for laboratories
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: analytical chemistry, flow cytometry, clinical microbiology, molecular diagnostics and materials characterization

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales teams serving pharmaceutical companies, hospitals and research institutions; distributors / dealers: local laboratory equipment and diagnostic distributors in selected markets; online: company web store for columns, consumables and replacement parts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: clinical diagnostic devices and assays subject to FDA oversight and EU in vitro diagnostic device rules
